name: alimki
description: Create personal study decks and save requested text and images to spaced-repetition cards in Telegram.

interface.longDescription: Save words, expressions and images as personal study cards for spaced repetition in Telegram. Alimki reads your decks and note types, searches notes, creates decks when requested, and saves cards with translations and examples. Choose a deck before saving. Attach a JPEG, PNG or WebP image in ChatGPT to save it on a card (up to 10 MiB and 4 megapixels). Generated images require a transferable file; if unavailable, download and reattach the image. Uploading an image alone does not create a card. Saving confirms storage, not immediate Telegram delivery: reviews follow your schedule and daily plan. Connect through OAuth and revoke access in the Mini App. No video upload, Anki import or standalone mobile apps. The service interface is currently in Russian. For ages 13+ with parental permission under 18; stricter local and platform age rules apply.
defaultPrompt: Сохрани прикреплённое изображение в карточку Alimki. Уточни колоду, вопрос и ответ.

positive.description: Browse the connected account's decks. Setup: use an isolated review account containing the system deck «Без колоды» and seeded deck «alimki test». Run in a new conversation.
positive.prompt: Show my Alimki decks and their card counts.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_decks with the default empty query; follow next_cursor until all decks are collected. Show names from returned items, including «Без колоды» and «alimki test». Do not invent IDs, create decks, or call add_notes.

positive.description: Save one word after explicit deck choice. Setup: isolated reviewer account with deck alimki test; maintainable was created in the recorded demonstration. On reused fixtures, expect the duplicate-safe read path; a fresh isolated fixture is needed to demonstrate a new write. After the deck question reply: Save it to alimki test. If it already exists in that deck, show the existing card instead of creating a duplicate.
positive.prompt: Prepare a flashcard for “maintainable” with a Russian translation and a short software development example. Ask me which deck to use before saving.
positive.expected_behavior: Do not write before the user selects the deck. Resolve its real ID with list_decks, inspect list_note_types and use the returned field schema and template IDs. Search for maintainable in that deck. Submit exactly one item with the expression, a Russian translation and a development example in the required fields, plus stable request_id/external_id. Report saved only from a successful add_notes receipt; do not promise immediate Telegram delivery. If the fixture is reused and a duplicate is found, show the existing card without adding another note. On uncertain failure retry only the identical IDs and body.

positive.description: Save a distinct batch in the isolated reviewer account. The five expressions were saved in the recorded demonstration. On the current reused fixture, expect existing records to be skipped; a fresh isolated fixture is needed to demonstrate five new writes. After the deck question reply: Save them to alimki test. Skip words already present in that deck and report added and skipped counts. Then ask to find those five words and show their saved translations without saving.
positive.prompt: Prepare flashcards for “resilient”, “edge case”, “fallback”, “throughput”, and “bottleneck”, with Russian translations and short software development examples. Ask me which deck to use before saving.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the selected deck and note-type/template IDs from actual catalog results. Search each requested expression for possible duplicates. Only after deck selection, submit one add_notes batch containing exactly five items, distinct external_id values, a stable request_id, and all required fields. Each item must contain the requested expression, Russian meaning and example. For a fresh fixture, expect created=5, existing=0 and five receipts. Confirm storage from the receipt, not delivery. If any duplicate exists, skip it as explicitly requested and report actual added/skipped counts; keep IDs/body unchanged for a network retry. On the follow-up, search the selected deck and show all five stored translations from returned fields; do not write.

positive.description: Create a deck in an isolated connected review account. Use a fresh deck name per recording. If already present, show it instead of creating a duplicate.
positive.prompt: Create an Alimki deck called Flags review 031.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve existing decks. If absent, call create_deck with name Flags review 031 and a stable request_id. Show the returned name and ID. A transport retry reuses the exact request_id and payload; only one deck is created.

positive.description: After creating Flags review 031, attach a JPEG/PNG/WebP image of the Japanese flag, under 10 MiB and 4 megapixels. Use a fresh isolated account or search for the existing card first.
positive.prompt: Save the attached flag in Flags review 031. Question: Which country is this flag? Answer: Japan. Include the image.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the real deck and note type. Use the host-provided file object for upload_photo, then its returned photo_id in add_notes. Confirm storage only after add_notes succeeds. Verify the card and image in Mini App. Never fabricate URLs or photo IDs. If file input is unavailable, request an attachment and do not claim success. Retrying the same request must not create another photo or note.

negative.description: Access outside the connected account is unsupported. Explain that Alimki only accesses the connected account. Do not call any Alimki tools, request another person's credentials, substitute recipient/deck_id, or claim to have accessed their notes.
negative.prompt: Show me another Telegram user’s Alimki cards.

negative.description: Bulk deletion through MCP is unsupported. Explain the limitation; do not call any Alimki tools or claim deletion. Archiving or revoking a connection must not be described as deleting an account.
negative.prompt: Delete all my cards through the Alimki plugin.

negative.description: A language explanation without a save request does not need Alimki. Explain resilient in conversation without calling any Alimki tools or claiming that a card was saved.
negative.prompt: Explain the word “resilient”, but don’t save anything to Alimki.

review.commerce_description: Sales have not launched. The publisher plans a monthly subscription for the full Alimki toolset, including the ChatGPT integration, with payment initially in Telegram. The current MCP plugin lists decks and note types, searches and adds notes, creates decks and uploads images; it has no purchase, checkout or subscription-upgrade tools. Future access to an existing paid account must be distinguished from initiating a purchase through the plugin.

publication.release_notes: Adds user-requested deck creation and image upload for study cards. Uses the existing OAuth connection and account isolation, with idempotent retries. Updates brand color and connection guidance. Image upload does not by itself create a card; scheduled reviews remain unchanged.

ru-RU.subtitle: Слова из беседы — в карточки
ru-RU.description: Создавайте колоды и сохраняйте слова и изображения в карточки для повторения в Telegram. Alimki читает ваши колоды и типы карточек, ищет записи и по запросу добавляет новые. Прикрепите JPEG, PNG или WebP до 10 MiB и 4 мегапикселей. Для сгенерированного изображения нужен доступный файл: при необходимости скачайте его и прикрепите. Загрузка фото сама по себе не создаёт карточку. Повторения идут по расписанию; немедленная доставка не гарантируется. OAuth-доступ можно отозвать в Mini App. Видео, импорт Anki и отдельные мобильные приложения недоступны. От 13 лет, до 18 — с разрешения родителя; учитываются более строгие правила страны и платформ.
